terra.problem: The passage does not say the leaders moved first or that everybody else lined up behind them. Nine out of ten of the remaining people were to stay in their towns.
The reference to the city's new wall is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The claim that traders from Tyre appear elsewhere in Nehemiah needs a reference.
The passage does not say that nobody had to argue or that the lots settled any argument.
The explanation is flat and repetitive. Its final two sentences restate that Jerusalem has this name without adding anything.
The claim that Jerusalem had been around a long time is a Bible fact from outside this passage and needs a reference.
The passage does not say the volunteers raised their hands, volunteered because nobody picked them, or stepped up first.
